---
title: "Life Expectancy Report for `r params$country`"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
params:
  country: "Afghanistan"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gapminder)
```

```{r}
#| label: country
params$country
```

```{r}
#| label: life-expectancy-data
life_expectancy <-
  gapminder |>
  filter(country == params$country)

life_expectancy$country[1]
```

## Life Expectancy in `r params$country`

```{r}
#| label: life-expectancy-plot
ggplot(data = life_expectancy, 
       aes(year, lifeExp)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = life_expectancy$country[1])
```
